money musik.bio: Money Musik, born Mohkom Singh Bhangal, is a Brampton, Ontario producer whose early work with Toronto artists including Pressa, WhyG, Casper TNG and LB Spiffy grew into an international production career. He became a key collaborator of NAV and produced the full AP Dhillon and Gurinder Gill album Not by Chance. Northern Dial carries one of the AP Dhillon, Gurinder Gill and Money Musik recordings from that era.

lincoln.bio: Lincoln Blaché is a Juno-nominated Canadian recording artist, songwriter and producer from Mississauga. He first gained wider recognition through his featured vocal on Doman & Gooding's dance single Runnin', then continued into independent music and artist development as founder of MADE IN SAUGA. Runnin' is the Lincoln credit in the Northern Dial library.

dj r dub l.bio: DJ R Dub L is a Canadian DJ, remixer, audio engineer and recording artist active in Saskatchewan's music community and through Motive Music Canada. His catalogue brings together Canadian hip-hop artists from multiple regions, including Bishop Brigante, JD Era, Thrust OG, Moka Only, Merkules and others. Exorcist with Bishop Brigante and JD Era is his Northern Dial library credit.

black-i.bio: Black-I was a Toronto hip-hop MC and dancer who emerged from the city's 1990s underground scene. A former backup dancer for Maestro Fresh Wes, he appeared on the landmark Canadian compilation Rap Essentials Volume One and later alongside Maestro and Ghetto Concept. Quintessential from Maestro's Built to Last and Ghetto Concept's Westend Story are his two Northern Dial library credits.

aristo.bio: Aristo is the recording name of Brione Wishart, a South America-born artist raised in Toronto's west end. He began writing and recording while still in school, later building an independent hip-hop career that included touring and releases such as Top of the World. Playa 4 Life from that project is his Northern Dial library credit.
